column4: dialect-gated: this job runs ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, so this test's per-dialect subtests for mysql and mssql skip while postgres runs. cleat#3009's TestExcludingDefinitionsFiltersBeforePaging iterates registeredBackends, the same shape as a-workflow-def-exposure-round-trips.tsv beside it. Measured by NAME on the cluster job's own environment: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestExcludingDefinitionsFiltersBeforePaging$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly two skips, .../mysql and .../mssql. This test writes no t.Skip of its own -- the skips come from backend.Setup's gate -- so scripts/check-skips.sh is correctly silent about it and this ledger line is the whole record.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2158): engine-race.yml is the only job that checks this key, and it sets one dialect at a time, so the other two arms skip there. Same shape and the same count as the pairing line in a-workflow-def-exposure-round-trips.tsv.
